goal: Generate a white-background product image directly usable as the main graphic on e-commerce platforms, with the product as the absolute visual focus.

subject.visual_description: Short gun-shaped body, main body in matte dark jade color, rear circular air intake mesh in deep purple copper color metal ring, handle has three physical buttons and a small status light area; beside it are magnetically placed a soft hair-drying nozzle and a styling nozzle, both with matching color metal rings
subject.angle: The main machine is arranged in a diagonal line with the bottom left and the vent at the top right in a 3/4 side view.

background.shadow: Slight bottom soft light shadow, separating components but not too heavy.

lighting.key_light: Soft light slightly above the front, emphasizing the texture of the concentric circles of the air intake mesh.
lighting.fill_light: Side soft light reduces overexposure on the metal ring

style.rendering: High resolution commercial photography + clean post-processing, with no scene elements
style.consistency: Colors restore authenticity, texture restores authenticity

must_keep: Clear details of the airflow network and button area.
The proportional relationship between the magnetic suction nozzle and the main unit is correct.
avoid: Metal ring highlight overexposed into a white line.
